title: Hold a licence to handle explosives
what: Manufacture explosives only at a licensed factory, and keep them only in a Government magazine or a magazine or premises the Director has licensed.

sources.title: Explosives Act 1936 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The manufacture of any explosive shall not nor shall any process of such manufacture be carried on except at a factory licensed for the same under regulations made or for the time being in force under this Act

sources.title: Explosives Act 1936 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Subject to subsection (2), explosives shall be kept only— (a) in a Government magazine; or (b) in a magazine duly licensed by the Director; or (c) on any premises duly licensed
